summary: Ran comprehensive pytest suite (21 tests) against Presento FastAPI backend via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Seeded test users/sessions directly in MongoDB for auth-gated tests. All 21 tests PASSED (root, auth, extract files/url, LLM validate with fake keys, presentations CRUD, HTML+PPTX export, Unsplash image generation).

minor.issue: Uses source.unsplash.com which Unsplash officially deprecated in 2023. Endpoint currently returns a URL string (no outbound call), but the returned URL may not resolve to a real image in production, affecting downstream PPTX image embedding.
On existing user login, inserts a new user_sessions doc each call without upserting/cleaning up old sessions -> unbounded growth. Consider upsert or TTL index on expires_at.
Accepts arbitrary dict body without Pydantic validation; silently allows writing extra unknown fields (only _id/user_id/presentation_id are stripped). Minor schema-safety concern.
No per-file or total size limit; a large upload could exhaust memory (reads entire file into RAM).

action_items: Consider replacing deprecated source.unsplash.com with Unsplash API (needs UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY) or Pexels/Pixabay stock source.
Add TTL index on user_sessions.expires_at and/or upsert by user_id to prevent unbounded session doc growth.
Add Pydantic model for presentation PUT body instead of raw dict.
Add an upload size limit (e.g., 20MB per file) on /api/extract/files.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~790 lines - borderline; consider splitting into routers (auth, extract, llm, images, presentations, export) for maintainability.
Synchronous httpx.get() call inside build_pptx (line ~669) blocks the event loop during PPTX export; should use async httpx or run build_pptx in a thread.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' while allow_credentials=True - this combination is rejected by browsers; for prod, set explicit origins in CORS_ORIGINS env.
user_sessions lacks TTL index; expired sessions are never cleaned up automatically.
Anthropic model hardcoded 'claude-haiku-4-5' in /llm/validate - if user's key doesn't have access to that model, validation may falsely fail.
No rate limiting on /llm/validate, /extract/url, /images/generate - abuse vectors.
/extract/url does not restrict schemes or block private IPs -> SSRF risk (e.g., http://169.254.169.254 metadata, http://localhost:8001).
test_credentials: No real credentials needed. Test user+session seeded directly in MongoDB (user_id=user_TEST_*, session_token=TEST_token_*) and cleaned up after run.
seed_data_creation: Session-scoped pytest fixture creates one TEST_ user + session in MongoDB and deletes them plus all TEST presentations on teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers 21 cases across all backend endpoints except /presentations/generate and /presentations/regenerate-slide (both require real LLM keys - only tested auth-gate on generate). PPTX zip header (PK) and HTML export verified. When retesting, reuse the seeded_user fixture pattern. SSRF in /extract/url is a potential issue worth exploring.
